games.name: The Long Drive
games.desc:
📄The Long Drive is an adventure racing simulator with an apocalyptic theme and elements of survival in the harsh conditions of the surrounding world.

📄E - Interaction.
📄Shift - Run.
📄F - Use headlights.
📄R - Reload.
📄Backspace - Throw away an item.
📄V - Release the mouse.
📄Q - Turn on the music.
📄H - Honk.
📄X - Turn signals.

💎The peculiarity of the game is that the world can change completely randomly, which will not allow you to anticipate or avoid a dangerous situation.

✅Avoid the Svintusov and get to Almaty with loot boxes!

📊You should always be prepared for unexpected turns of events, strive to develop the main character, and also not forget about the main means of transportation.

📝Many features were taken from the original The Long Drive game, but we tried to change most of the mechanics.

games.name: (PT3!!) Critical Revengeance
games.desc:
Welcome to Critical Revengeance! An open-world game that is a harder spin on the CA Genre (Although still heavily WIP.)

Please be aware that (MOST) of the songs in CR are from outside sources and are not original, and upon request will be removed if need be.
We DO have some official OSTs though.
AZALI has granted us permission to use their songs, as long as it isn't a commissioned song.

This game is still in public testing phases, so expect MANY bugs, unfinished content, a lack of content, incorrect balancing, and anything to change. This game is mostly meant for PC, but it has some mobile and console support.

This game is developed by two people, one working on a backend recode. Game is still getting updated during recode period. Please know that updates will be way slower and inconsistent, and is a passion project.
